title: Predicting longitudinal state-selective calcium activity across identified neurons
disposition_reason: The fixed-origin event-rate scoring equation is implemented over the complete declared cohort. Authentic event/mask production, MCH thresholds and longitudinal identities are not, so neither published preference-label figures nor a full-shaped generated forecast establish a measured forecast result.

scientific_target.question: After nine calibration sessions, how well can the future state-conditioned event rates of the same identified neurons be predicted through acute and chronic recovery, beyond stationary and slow-drift references?
scientific_target.known_answer: For each neuron and wake/NREM/REM state in sessions 10–21, log1p(60×event_count/valid_stable_seconds), defined only with at least 20 seconds qualified stable-state exposure.
scientific_target.answer_origin: A frozen source-qualified calcium-event and hypnogram pipeline. Current scorer accepts counts/exposures but does not extract them or resolve group-specific MCH threshold.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held-mouse fixed-origin forecast containing all tracked cells, states and future sessions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse:31 mice across five groups; cells/sessions/states are nested. Group sizes are 6,6,6,7,6.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Prediction conditional on offline processed fluorescence and retrospectively established neuron correspondence; measured calcium events are not direct spikes.
exclusions: Historical all 21-session preference-label reconstruction as protected forecasting.
Causal effects of neurons or sleep deprivation from this fixed within-animal design.
Prospective cell discovery or unbiased neuron survival from retrospective ROI matching.

inputs: Held-mouse sessions 1–9 neural calibration and allowed acquisition-time/condition metadata, with train-only predictor scaling.
Other mice in the same predefined training split for model selection; whole longitudinal cell identity is disclosed retrospective side information.
forbidden_inputs: Held-mouse sessions 10–21 fluorescence, events, state rates, future exposure values or all-trajectory normalization.
Maximum across allsessions/states used in triangular visualization.
Target updates between forecast sessions; evaluator-only label permutations or future target durations.
observation_contract.case_identity: Scorer keys predictions by(mouse_id, neuron_id) and requires a full 36-slot future vector per cell. Actual authenticated cell/animal correspondence is not supplied by the schema.
observation_contract.split: Proposed leave-one-mouse-out within group; held sessions 1–9 calibrate once, all 10–21 predicted open-loop. Internal selection mirrors the same origin on other mice.
observation_contract.coverage: Numerical consumer requires all 1,661 cells,31 mice, fivegroups and 21 source sessions; 59,796 future state slots before exposure masking. These are declared cardinalities, not verified archive coverage.

primary.name: Equal-group fixed-origin squared log1p event-rate error
primary.aggregation: Equal eligible future sessions per neuron/state, equal eligible states per neuron, neurons per mouse, mice per group, then all five groups equally.
primary.rationale: Avoids weighting by imaging frames, exposure duration or cell-rich groups; missing/underexposed states are not zero rates.

secondary: Paired reference-minus-candidate loss on identical masks.
Preference-label persistence and occupancy-preserving shuffles only as separate retrospective diagnostics.

comparators.name: Stationary per-cell state-rate reference
comparators.inputs: Held-cell sessions 1–9 plus shrinkage fitted on training mice.
comparators.procedure: Freeze exposure-weighted calibration estimate and propagate unchanged.

comparators.name: Group/context reference
comparators.inputs: Region/genotype and permitted acquisition context; training mice and first 9 sessions only.
comparators.procedure: Fit hierarchical state-rate model with no future state-duration targets.

comparators.name: Slow-drift reference
comparators.procedure: Select regularized state-space/random-walk model on other mice, propagate open-loop from session 9; use strongest validation-selected member of complete baseline set.

nuisance_controls: Require genuine 20-second stable-bout exposures and explicit missing reasons; never convert missing to zero.
Qualify group-specific event thresholds including MCH and actual clocks/Zeitgeber context.
Compare retrospective ROI-identity mismatch and normalization sensitivity.
LH-Vgat active/quiet-wake validation cannot be assumed validated in other groups.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired mouse-level intervals or hierarchical resampling preserving full cell trajectories; 6–7 mice per group. Existing pure scorer does not implement uncertainty.
evaluation.failure_policy: Complete cell support and finite full future vectors required for candidate and comparator. Shared source exposure masks determine eligibility; all five groups need eligible data for primary. Malformed targets are intake errors, not candidate failures.

implementation.scorer_target: Actual future calcium event-rate forecasts on sessions 10–21, not a match to source paper labels or plots; producer receipts identify but do not authenticate target derivation.
implementation.delivered_scope: Standalone standard-library scorer, source-authenticated file CLI and generated complete-cohort interface checks. No observation packet, event producer, programme executor or reference fit.
missing: Authenticate complete cohort, ROI correspondence, stable-state masks and group event pipeline including MCH.
Deliver first 9-session-only candidate inputs and qualified strongest training-only comparator.
Implement protected fixed-origin execution and mouse-level uncertainty.
implementation.execution_evidence: Generated source and relocation controls test complete dimensions, masking and hierarchical aggregation. No authentic full-cohort prediction, biological finding or new model result is established.

direct_observation.representation: Potential direct numerical trajectory forecast from first 9 sessions and same state/context information.
direct_observation.boundary: Would require explicit complete case serialization; a table of already computed targets cannot stand in for neural observation.
missing: Bounded complete neural-history packet and no-tools response interface.

typed_viewer.representation: A longitudinal trace/state viewer could support inspection without changing the forecast target.
typed_viewer.boundary: Must stop at fixed origin and avoid future-normalized visualizations or all-session target panels.
missing: Typed restricted history-only views and response collection.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-held-mouse numerical modelling of first 9-session histories.
tool_assisted.boundary: No target refresh; same calibrated history and training provenance as programme comparator.
missing: Candidate episode interface; scorer alone does not deliver investigative tools.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted open-loop programme produces 36 future values per neuron.
frozen_program.boundary: Fit/adapt only on declared training mice and held first 9 sessions, freeze all future forecasts together.
missing: Source input/target producers, programme runner and competent fitted references.

evidence.supports: Preserved source-backed registration, prospective scientific design and original exposure limitations; current implementation changes are described separately.
score validates 1,661 cells/31 mice and evaluates sessions 10–21 log1p event rates from fixed origin 9, equal eligible-session/state/cell/mouse/group weighting.
Delivered pure scorer excludes event extraction, model execution, identity qualification and competent baseline fitting.

evidence.locator: Longitudinal calcium and sleep-state methods, audited in original registration
evidence.supports: Five groups,31 mice,1,661 cells; offline processing/ROI matching and missing MCH event-threshold limitation.
Named complete longitudinal source; a two-MCH-mouse demonstration is insufficient for the registered cohort.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: The inspected source carries construction and generated software-control evidence. No neural programme pilot among the four historical EEG/sleep attempts is attributed to this registration, and no model or human outcome is added here.
excluded_claims: Historical all 21-session preference-label reconstruction as protected forecasting.
Causal effects of neurons or sleep deprivation from this fixed within-animal design.
Prospective cell discovery or unbiased neuron survival from retrospective ROI matching.
A declared full-size scorer input as authenticated 1,661-cell source coverage.

summary: Replace stale no-scorer claim with the implemented fixed-origin numerical endpoint, without promoting absent event/identity construction.
Separate future-rate prediction from historical preference-label reconstruction and all-session normalization.
Preserve masking and session→state→cell→mouse→group weighting with a 31-mouse uncertainty unit.
revision.source_review: Reused the preserved registration primary-source audit and inspected the listed actual implementation paths. No authentic numerical payload or protected label was opened; no model was run.
